MTS Bionix® Tabletop Test Systems
Product catalog summary
Overview:
MTS Bionix® Tabletop Test Systems are compact servohydraulic systems designed for biomedical testing, focusing on biomaterials and medical components to ensure compliance with industry standards.
Key Features:
Axial Configuration: Suitable for various tests including fatigue life and fracture growth, supporting up to ±25 kN and displacements of ±50 mm.
Axial/Torsional Configuration: Allows biaxial testing with torsional moments up to ±250 N·m and rotations of 270°, ideal for implant testing.
Applications:
Biomaterial Characterization: Tests for yield strength, fatigue, and wear characteristics.
Biomechanical Component Testing: Includes fatigue certification and implant studies.
Simulation of Biological Forces: Kinematic and wear studies of implants.
Performance and Safety:
Stiff load frames for rigidity and alignment.
Ergonomic design and on-frame controls for safety and efficiency.
Exceeds CE safety guidelines with powered crosshead positioning.
Integrated Solutions:
Includes MTS SilentFlo™ HPUs and MTS TestSuite™ software.
MTS FlexTest® digital controllers for multi-channel testing.
Accessories like grips and extensometers enhance capabilities.
Specifications:
Load frames available in standard or extended heights with detailed specifications.
Service and Support:
Comprehensive service including installation, training, and maintenance.
Extended warranty options and custom test template development.
Additional Specifications:
Rotary Actuator: Stroke of ±135 degrees with torque ratings of ±100 N-m and ±200 N-m.
Hydraulic Power Unit: Pressure of 14 MPa with a flow rate of 15 l/min.
Load Frame Model 370.02: Features servovalves with flow ratings and actuator static forces.
Performance Curves: Includes graphs showing specimen displacement versus frequency and piston rod displacement versus frequency.
Contact Information: MTS Systems Corporation provides regional contact details for customer support.
Certifications: ISO 9001 certified, ensuring quality management standards.
